computation-library-root.description: Equity ESG using Inverse Gamma model

columns.c:
if\straded_idx\s=\s-1\sthen\s
 \s\s\s\sreturn\s0
 else
 K\s=\sS[traded_idx]
 T\s=\screditing_term_post_ratesetting
 put_price\s=\sinverse_gamma_option_price(S[traded_idx],K,swap_rate,T,Computation[step].k_average[traded_idx],Computation[step].theta[traded_idx],Computation[step].lambda_average[traded_idx],\sComputation[step].xi_average[traded_idx],\srho,vol[traded_idx],div_minus_f)
 call_price\s=\sput_price\s+\sS[traded_idx]*exp(-div_minus_f*T)\s-\sK*exp(-swap_rate*T)
 
 return\scall_price/S[traded_idx]
 end

/*\sFor\sapproach\s2\s
 k*\sis\sthe\scut\soff\sstrike
 If\sk*=200%,\sp\swould\sbe\sf(k*).\sIf\sk*<200%,\sset\sp\sto\sbe\sf(k*)*BS(200%)/\sBS(k*)
 where\sBS(K)\sis\sthe\sBS\soption\sprice\swith\srespect\sto\sstrike\sK.\s*/
 if\straded_idx\s=\s-1\sthen\s
 \s\s\s\sreturn\s0
 else
 if\s$index\s>\scut_off_strike\sthen\s
 \s\s\scall_price_prev\s=\sig_otm_calls[cut_off_strike]
 \s\s\sig_strike_prev\s=\sig_strike[cut_off_strike]
 \s\s\sK_star\s=\sS[traded_idx]\s*\s(1\s+\sig_strike_prev)
 \s\s\sk_max\s=\sig_strike[len(ig_strike)-1]
 \s\s\sK_end\s=\sS[traded_idx]\s*\s(1\s+\sk_max)
 \s\s\sT\s=\screditing_term_post_ratesetting
 \s\s\sr\s=\sswap_rate
 \s\s\sif\scompare(compute_black_scholes(S[traded_idx],K_star,r,T,bs_vol[traded_idx],div_minus_f)\s<=0,1E-04)\sthen
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\s0
 \s\s\selse
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\scall_price_end\s=\scall_price_prev*max(0,compute_black_scholes(S[traded_idx],K_end,r,T,bs_vol[traded_idx],div_minus_f))/compute_black_scholes(S[traded_idx],K_star,r,T,bs_vol[traded_idx],div_minus_f)\s\s\s
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sig_strike_current\s=\sig_strike[$index]
 \s\s\s\s\s\s\s\sreturn\s((call_price_end\s-\scall_price_prev)*(ig_strike_current\s-\sk_max))/(k_max-ig_strike_prev)\s+\scall_price_end
 \s\s\send
 else
 \s\s\sreturn\s\sig_otm_calls[$index]
 end
 end
